thread:
Jamie: Quick sync — we need a strict apples-to-apples run comparing Mistral vs Redwood-13b after the kernel-selector change. Focus: tokenizer alignment, stop sequences, identical decoding params, KV warm/cold. Plan: synthetic steady load + replay of 30m prod. Anyone object?
Priya: +1. We need a hard guardrail for tokenization — last time tokenization drifted and ruin stopseq checks.
Min: I wrote a tiny wrapper to enforce tokenizer parity, see snippet:
```
# enforce tokenizer alignment before runs
./harness/run_pair_eval \
  --model-a mistral --tokenizer-a hf/mistral \
  --model-b redwood-13b --tokenizer-b hf/redwood \
  --align-tokenizer true --seed 42
```
Diego: Heads up — align-tokenizer can be lossy w/ some unicode sequences. Suggest running token-diff first: `python tools/token_diff.py --pair mistral,redwood --samples 1000`
sasha: For decoding params let's pin them explicitly: `temperature=0.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=40, repetition_penalty=1.0, stop=["\n\n","</s>"], max_new_tokens=128`. Use same for both models.
ci-bot: kernel-selector v2 deployed to canary (build 5421) :white_check_mark:
Jamie: Good. KV cache plan: run both cold-start (new process per request pattern) and warm-start (session reuse) runs. Commands I'm proposing:
```
# replay harness (cold)
./run_replay --input prod_30m.jsonl --model mistral --replay-mode=cold --concurrency=16 --duration=30m
# replay harness (warm)
./run_replay --input prod_30m.jsonl --model redwood-13b --replay-mode=warm --cache-reuse=true --concurrency=16 --duration=30m
```
Priya: Add pprof snapshots every 60s, GPU counters (nvidia-smi), and enable `runtime.kernel_choice=DEBUG` so we log kernel selection. Also capture oom/gpu-saturation events.
Min: Also sweep batching heuristics: `batch_max_items=64`, `batch_max_tokens=4096`, and vary `batch_latency_ms` between 6 and 12 to see latency vs throughput.
Diego: Note: kernel selector will often pick INT8 kernels for Redwood q4 and FP16 for Mistral. If we can't force the exact kernel, annotate that in results and try `runtime.force_kernel=baseline` to force same path (if supported).
sasha: I'll prepare the prompt suite — exact same prompts for both models (see internal suite: http://internal/suites/apples/2024-12-01). Use seed=42. We'll also include a small adversarial set for stop-sequence edge cases.
Jamie: Runbook: flag a perf-regression if p50 increases >10% or p99 >20% vs baseline. Also require output-equality checks: exact matches after trimming stop tokens. Use `scripts/compare_outputs.py --trim-stop` for diffs.
Priya: I'll own the replay runs tonight in lab (region=us-west2). I'll enable synthetic tests as well (`synthetic_client --poisson`) to introduce arrival jitter.
ci-bot: replay job queued: id=7421 — logs at http://ci/replay/7421 :bookmark_tabs:
Min: Important — collect batch composition histograms (how often different seq-lengths co-occur in the same batch). Config to enable:
```
runtime.metrics.batch_histogram=true
runtime.metrics.histogram_buckets=[0,32,64,128,256,512,1024]
```
Diego: Also capture kernel selection counts per batch and a mapping of (batch_size, avg_seq_len) -> chosen_kernel to help tune selector heuristics.
sasha: I'll add dashboard panels: per-model p50/p95/p99, kernel-choice breakdown, avg batch size, batch latency distribution, token-level throughput, and stopseq-failure rate.
Jamie: Once jobs finish, please post artifacts: pprof tarball, batch histograms, token-diff results, and trimmed outputs. Priya can you paste links & summary here? cc @sasha @Min
Priya: Will do — starting runs now, expect artifacts in the morning. :thumbsup:
Jamie: Thanks all. If any run shows p99 >20% we stop rollout and investigate kernel choices first.
Min: Quick reminder — for synthetic tests use both poisson and steady-rate to catch batching edge cases; synthetic steady can mask bursts.
Diego: Agreed. Also remember to tag each run w/ `force_kernel` / `batch_policy` metadata so we can filter artifacts later.
ci-bot: artifact upload: s3://redwood-ci/replay/7421/artifacts.tar.gz
Priya: Uploaded results summary: http://internal/artifacts/replay-7421/summary.html — will drop raw pprof + csvs in the bucket in 10m.
Jamie: Perfect. We'll triage in the morning. :eyes:"
